# Brasiliansk presidentskräll  – ny tung rapportvecka

**Feed**: efn-borsfrukost  
**Published**: 2026-10-26  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

EFN Morgon opens a heavy reporting week after a volatile one in which Stockholm's broad index fell about 2%. Lula da Silva's surprise win in Brazil's presidential election is hitting Brazilian assets and Swedish iGaming stocks, because his proposed gambling ban becomes more likely. The hosts also cover oil still above 110 USD, rising inflation worries ahead of the Fed, the neocloud credit squeeze, and this week's US tech reports (Alphabet, Microsoft) after Meta and Tesla showed AI costs climbing sharply. Addnode is the bright spot after a strong report and several raised price targets.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟠 ANOD-B — Addnode | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Strong Q report with organic growth back and sharp profit growth; three analysts raised price targets.

#### Reasoning

Cited analyst opinion: three price-target raises after a report showing a return to organic growth and very strong profit growth. The hosts call it Friday's big winner but give no explicit buy call of their own, so this is a positive watch backed by momentum and analyst upgrades.

#### Sell Triggers

- if organic growth reverses next quarter
- if margin expansion proves temporary

> *"Noterar att Addnode får höjda riktkurser från inte mindre än tre olika analytiker den här morgonen."*

---

### 🟠 EVO — Evolution | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 60%

Lula's win makes a Brazil gambling ban more likely; betting sector expected down today; unclear how much is priced in.

#### Reasoning

The hosts expect Swedish betting stocks to fall at the open after Lula's surprise win, since he wants to ban gambling in Brazil (still needs Congress). Evolution's CEO already operates as if it is banned. The hosts ask whether the drop is already priced in, so this is a cautious watch with negative tilt.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the Brazilian Congress approves the gambling ban
- if Brazil revenue loss proves larger than priced

> *"Nu ska vi se bettingsektorn ner på detta idag."*

---

### ⛔ CRWV — CoreWeave | **AVOID** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 40%

Musk says credit markets have shut on neocloud financing; expects widespread deaths and consolidation.

#### Reasoning

Cited opinion from Elon Musk, not the hosts: neocloud financing has dried up. The hosts say his remark may add fuel to the fire in the short term after CoreWeave was pressured hard last week.

#### Sell Triggers

- if credit markets reopen to neocloud financing

> *"Och ett sådant här uttalande kan ju bli lite bränsle på elden kortsiktigt tänker jag."*

---

### ⛔ NBIS — Nebius | **AVOID** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 40%

Pressured hard last week; Musk's neocloud credit warning seen as short-term fuel on the fire.

#### Reasoning

Same neocloud credit-squeeze story as CoreWeave; the view comes from Musk's quote and the host's short-term remark, not an explicit host call.

#### Sell Triggers

- if financing conditions for neoclouds improve
